basis.governing_question: Should Quinta Azul enter the retail markets of Spain, France, Germany and Poland, and in which order?

sub_questions.question: How attractive is each of the four retail markets for Quinta Azul's olive oil?
Can Quinta Azul win in each market, given its assets, competitors and customer needs?
What entry option and business case fit each market that stays under consideration?
Which of the four countries is a go and which a no-go?
In what order should the countries that are a go be entered?

drivers.evidence: retail markets of Spain, France, Germany and Poland

work.unit: Market assessed in full (demand, channels, competitors, regulation, buyer interviews)

phase_work.why: Four markets screened together, assumed shortlist of three assessed two at a time; capability-to-win assessment runs alongside. Top end passes the typical 4-8 weeks.

work.unit: Entry option and business case for one market
Entry sequence and roadmap across markets

phase_work.why: Three business cases run two at a time, then the entry sequence; top end passes the typical 3-6 weeks because pieces run in series.

sizing.levers: Shortlisting two markets after desk screening instead of three would cut about 2-3 weeks from Research and 1-2 from Design.

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Assess the attractiveness of each of the four markets and Quinta Azul's ability to win in them.

gate.label: Shortlist decision
gate.decision: Which markets go forward into entry design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the entry option and business case for each shortlisted market and the sequence across them.

gate.label: Final decision
gate.decision: Approve the go or no-go for each country and the entry sequence?

architect_notes: Length is not given: phases are estimated at 8-9 and 5-6 weeks, inside estimates of 7-10 and 4-7; confirm before quoting.
Assessing three markets in full after desk screening is assumed; all four take the same time, so confirm whether a desk-based no-go is enough.
Research reaches 10 weeks if screening takes 2 weeks and each full assessment 3; Design reaches 7 if business cases and roadmap take 2 each.
